gui.omnira.engine.guide.mechanical.0: Install a spell core: Primordial supplies 512 base su; Dream supplies 1024. Both run at 16 rpm. This demonstration uses a Primordial core.
gui.omnira.engine.guide.mechanical.1: Basic, Elemental, Arcane and Omni grids give 1.2x, 1.5x, 2x and 4x. Three Elemental grids multiply 512 su by 1.5 x 1.5 x 1.5, giving 1728 su at the same speed.
gui.omnira.engine.guide.mechanical.2: Redstone control defaults to on: a signal starts the engine. Disable redstone control for continuous operation. The main switch always overrides it.
gui.omnira.engine.guide.mechanical.3: The opposite side reveals the output shaft. The rear button or interface arrows reverse its rotation.
gui.omnira.engine.guide.mechanical.4: Align the engine output with the shaft at the back of the assembly table. Add ingredients and start the engine: the hammer forges automatically. Collect the finished item.
gui.omnira.engine.guide.electric.0: The shaft face exports FE: Primordial supplies 512 base FE/s; Dream supplies 1024. Connect FE-compatible cables, storage or machines. This demonstration uses a Primordial core.
gui.omnira.engine.guide.electric.1: Grids also boost electricity. Three Elemental grids raise Primordial output to 1728 FE/s. Cores and grids are not consumed.
gui.omnira.engine.guide.electric.2: Generation follows the power and redstone controls. Switching the engine off stops its power output.
gui.omnira.engine.guide.electric.3: Electricity works without Create, and both outputs can operate together. Reversing the shaft does not affect electricity.
gui.omnira.engine.guide.electric.4: The shaft can also drive an assembly table directly while electricity remains available. This automatic forging uses shaft power, not FE.

tooltip.omnira.traveler_manuscript: The cover reads: 'I got transported to Terra?!'
gui.omnira.traveler_manuscript.page.1: I actually arrived on Terra! A voice told me Terra needs me to save it. I'll record everything that happens next! Too bad that voice has been silent ever since I got here.
gui.omnira.traveler_manuscript.page.2: I wonder if Kal'tsit is in this world. As the Doctor, I'm off to find my little operators and throw a party. I hope Priestess doesn't kill me...
gui.omnira.traveler_manuscript.page.3: I went to the library. Plenty of war records, but hardly any of my operators. Someone said the building next door is Terra's Imperial Palace and I shouldn't go near it. Since when did Terra have a palace?
gui.omnira.traveler_manuscript.page.4: All right, kids, this manuscript ends here. I awakened psychic powers and saw the Emperor clogging a pipe. He said the broadcast was his. Then the four Chaos brats hit me in the face. What the hell kind of Terra is this?!
